audit_items.proof_trace: The recovered cells from kzg.RecoverCellsAndKZGProofs are never verified against the KZG commitments. Line 108-109 states 'Input sidecars are verified, and we reconstructed ourselves the missing sidecars. As a consequence, reconstructed sidecars are also verified' but this is a logical fallacy - no cryptographic verification is performed. The code wraps recovered cells directly into VerifiedRODataColumn (line 117) without calling VerifyCellKZGProofBatch.
audit_items.attack_scenario: An attacker who compromises the c-kzg-4844 library or exploits a bug in the FFT recovery algorithm can return arbitrary cell data that does not match the polynomial committed to by the KZG commitments. Since no verification is performed, the node will accept and propagate incorrect data column sidecars, breaking data availability guarantees across the network.
